name: drawscape-outreach

scripts.db:init: mkdir -p data && sqlite3 data/outreach.sqlite < db/schema.sql && npm run db:migrate
scripts.companies: sqlite3 -header -column data/outreach.sqlite "SELECT id, name, domain, employee_count, employee_count_range, description, linkedin_company_url FROM companies ORDER BY name;"
scripts.people: sqlite3 -header -column data/outreach.sqlite "SELECT p.id, p.profile_key, p.name, p.status, p.qualified, p.linkedin_profile_url FROM people p ORDER BY p.name;"
scripts.positions: sqlite3 -header -column data/outreach.sqlite "SELECT pos.id, p.name AS person, pos.title, c.name AS company, pos.is_current FROM positions pos JOIN people p ON p.id = pos.person_id JOIN companies c ON c.id = pos.company_id ORDER BY c.name, p.name;"

description: Prospecting workspace for finding companies and people to contact
